name: Queensland
summary: A British blue ensign with a light blue disc in the fly bearing a blue Maltese cross topped by a crown.
origin: The colony of Queensland adopted its badge in 1876. The crown was changed to the St Edward's Crown in 1953.

symbols.name: Maltese cross
symbols.description: A light blue Maltese cross on the disc.
symbols.meaning: Commonly linked to the Victoria Cross, the highest military award.

symbols.name: Crown
symbols.description: St Edward's Crown on the cross.
symbols.meaning: The monarchy; Queensland is named after Queen Victoria.

facts: Queensland is named after Queen Victoria.
Its Maltese cross is often compared to the Victoria Cross medal.
clues: A blue ensign with a light blue disc holding a Maltese cross and crown.
Its state is named after a queen.
Its cross is linked to a military medal.
